name: Wuhu State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission (Wuhu SASAC)
note: State-assets regulator of the Wuhu Municipal People's Government (Anhui, China). Per Chery Automobile's HKEX prospectus (2025-09-17), Wuhu SASAC owns 95.59% of Wuhu Investment Holding, which is Chery's single largest shareholder with 20.08% of the enlarged share capital at listing.
